title: CommonDomainEventEnvelope
description: Common envelope shared by all Fabric_4L canonical domain and integration events. Reuses patterns from the Layer 4 workflow replay envelope and generalizes them for cross-layer use.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the event context

actor.description: Entity that caused the event (user id, service name, provider id)

causation_id.description: Id of the event or command that caused this event

event_type.description: Canonical event type from the Event Catalog

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the payload schema

payload_pointer.description: Reference to the payload (URI, object-store key, or inline pointer)

payload_checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum (sha-256) of the serialized payload

payload_redacted.description: Redacted payload summary for audit logs where full payload is sensitive
